reviews.comment: phd student first time teaching & was very nice & caring but mediocre kinda rambles & tad unclear but overall good. Roughly weekly easy hw. Basically all info u need for the class is in the slides which r bit convoluted. Exams r incredibly easy. Really ez class especially if you have prior coding experience, just need to learn a few stats concepts

Great professor. Even if this is her first year of teaching, I'd say she is good. Her office hours and recitations are really helpful when dealing with homework, since they make up 40% of the total grade.

This was her first year teaching this course and she was great! She's very sweet and cares about her students. Her lectures were very helpful for explaining terms and coding. They are helpful when it comes to the quizzes, midterm, and final. The homework isn't too hard if you understand the lecture slides, and it's 40% of your grade so do it!
